newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat narrowly mixed as corn, soybeans gyrate.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat narrowly mixed as corn, soybeans gyrate.

text.p: Volatile moves in corn and soybean futures led to a mixed picture for CBOT wheat futures at midsession with commercials and speculators on each side of the market dealing in small amounts, traders said.
Wheat export news was about as expected and new crop July, especially in the Kansas City hard red winter market, was pressured by moisture falling over the U.S. winter wheat growing region.
USDA early Friday said U.S. net export sales of wheat during the week ended February 13 totaled 287,200 tonnes, near the high end of expectations for 250,000 to 300,000 tonnes.
But other export news was sparse with Taiwan setting a tender for 69,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat Thursday and the Philippines overnight buying 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

FIMAT Futures and Griffin Trading each bought one million bushels of July while E.D. and F. Man and Rand Financial each sold one million bushels of July, traders said. Refco Inc bought and sold one half milion bushels of March and R.J. O'Brien bought one half million bushels of March, traders said.
At 1149 CST, wheat was 1/2 cent a bushel lower to 1-1/4 higher, with March down 1/2 at $3.63-1/4.
